title: mmt-plugin import --json result, schema_version 1
description: The result of import (docs/design/cli.md, section 6). Paths are relative to the project (-C) when inside it (POSIX separators), absolute otherwise. With --dry-run, or when the output is in the way, nothing is written and the action is would-*; an unchanged output is not rewritten.

input.description: The PDL v1 model read, or <stdin>.

model_hash.description: The sha256 of the PDL v1 model as read.

offsets.description: absolute (the plugin.yaml default), or running when the model does not analyse because of a duplicate name the Java tool accepted (model.legacy-duplicate-name).

sha256.description: The plugin.yaml as import writes it.
